rows.description: map: Given person + topic, discover and structure their public arguments
verify: Given extracted claims, trace to original sources and cross-reference
track: Monitor how a person's arguments evolve over time, detect stance shifts, abandoned claims, and new positions
Structured I/O: Every function takes typed objects in, returns typed objects out. No string parsing.
JSON by default: CLI outputs JSON. `--markdown` flag for human-readable reports.
Streaming progress: Long-running operations emit progress events agents can monitor.
Composable: `map` and `verify` are independent. An agent can map first, review claims, then selectively verify.
Deterministic: Same inputs produce structurally consistent outputs (content varies with web results).
Importable: Any TypeScript agent does `import { mapArguments, verifyClaims } from './argumentmapper'`.
Scaffold project: `~/Desktop/projects/argumentmapper/`, package.json, tsconfig
`src/lib/types.ts`: All TypeScript interfaces
`src/lib/search.ts`: Query decomposition + parallel agent search
`src/cli.ts`: Basic CLI that runs search: `argumentmapper search "Person" "Topic"`
`src/lib/classify.ts`: Port Sourcerer's classification to TypeScript
`src/lib/extract.ts`: Three-pass LLM extraction pipeline
Wire up CLI `map` command: Full pipeline: search → classify → extract
`src/lib/verify.ts`: Claim decomposition + evidence search + scoring
Wire up CLI `verify` command: Takes profile JSON, outputs VerificationReport
`src/lib/store.ts`: Snapshot persistence (save/load/list/diff)
`src/lib/track.ts`: Evolution analysis (date-filtered search + period diffing)
Wire up CLI `track` command: Stores snapshots, shows evolution
Markdown templates: Rich output format for `--markdown` flag
PAI skill wrapper: `skills/ArgumentMapper/SKILL.md` that shells out to the CLI
Register in skill-index.json
